summary: The line cuts through bush off the street's end; no usable kerb.
reasons: No road edge to stop on

drivers.seclusion: Thick bush behind, but a dwelling stands 12 m from the line.
drivers.access_and_room: Only the line's far end meets the street edge; no pull-off or track seen.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 9-5 signs only; no parked vehicles at this spot.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the north and east.
